name: Music
description: AI music generation for TheItemApp. Type a style and (optionally) lyrics, and a HeartMuLa music-generation engine produces a full song with vocals. Ships a Studio prefab for composing tracks and a Player prefab for browsing and playing your generated library, over a single `music_tracks` data model. Backed by a music-api proxy over a self-contained, Apache-2.0 HeartMuLa engine on the GPU.
